# Agent Rules
 
## Start with the wiki
 
At the start of each task, check `_context/wiki/index.md` to decide
whether wiki context is needed before acting. Don’t read the wiki in
full. Use the index and follow links only when they are relevant to
the task.
 
## Update the wiki
 
After completing a task, offer to update the wiki if the task yielded durable knowledge that could benefit future work, then wait for user approval. This includes new processes, architecture decisions, or insights that go beyond the immediate task.
 
## Give honest feedback and analysis
 
When providing feedback, analysis, reviews, or verification, use the
`professional-honesty` skill. Prioritize technical accuracy over
agreeableness: verify claims before agreeing, disagree respectfully when the
evidence contradicts, surface problems directly instead of sugarcoating, and
be explicit about uncertainty. Don't declare success on partial checks — say
exactly what was and wasn't verified. Objective correction serves the work
better than false agreement.
